function stakingPlans(uint256) view returns (string name, uint256 duration, uint256 apy, uint256 minAmount, bool active)
function userStakes(address, uint256) view returns (uint256 amount, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 planId, uint256 rewards, bool withdrawn)
function calculateRewards(address user, uint256 stakeIndex) view returns (uint256)
function getUserStakes(address user) view returns (tuple(uint256 amount, uint256 startTime, uint256 endTime, uint256 planId, uint256 rewards, bool withdrawn)[])
event Staked(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint256 planId, uint256 stakeIndex)
event Unstaked(address indexed user, uint256 amount, uint256 rewards, uint256 stakeIndex)
event RewardsClaimed(address indexed user, uint256 rewards, uint256 stakeIndex)
